approval.authority: User explicitly approved the protocol choices in the active 2026-11-18 development session before new science execution

base_protocol.policy: Preserve original bytes and all previous attempted-result interpretation

primary_estimators.partial_rate: endpoint_rate*branch_frequency; diagnostic, not a substituted primary gate
primary_estimators.event_time_exposure_MLE: separately named D/sum(min(t_event,T)) diagnostic; never selected after inspecting outputs

statistical_design.independent_unit: immutable original-parent trajectory; equal initial represented number within each binomial cohort
statistical_design.linked_interval_method: two-sided exact Clopper-Pearson with Bonferroni allocation over all frozen branch claims
statistical_design.precision_denominator: independent source branch probability, fixed before sampling
statistical_design.zero_source_branch: zero observed events required; never assign an invented relative precision
statistical_design.membership: Freeze every species/channel/source/seed/dt/weight/order/MPI claim before execution; no dropped-channel renormalization

random_stream.uniform_grid: first52 HMAC bits; exact (k+1/2)*2^-52 midpoint; strict open interval
random_stream.matched_comparisons: same physical cohort/key across timestep and MPI layouts; original histories stay independent within each cohort
random_stream.finite_resolution: Record maximum draw family and finite-grid/exponential-tail bound; no infinite-real-uniform claim

execution.large_cohorts: Defer to an explicitly requested cluster package; never shorten criteria/cohorts silently
execution.formal_requirements: Actual source/state/provider/build/native/numerical/ledger evidence and same-campaign predecessors remain mandatory
